two_axes.evidence: r38_opportunity.STATUS — what is known about the opportunity
two_axes.operator: OPERATOR_STATE — whether anyone can execute it
two_axes.why: a thing can be a real economic signal and have nobody to build it. Collapsing the two into one number is how an archetype starts looking like a deal.

operator_ladder.means: a business-model shape tied to an observed capability gap. No operator, no local validation. NOT an opportunity.
the economic conditions this model needs are established in this place -- both the demand side and the cost side
a real, named operator exists and has said they are interested. Only a recorded response can reach this state.
an identified operator, validated economics, a capital requirement and terms

origination_types.DISCOVER: identify an existing business that could expand, be acquired, or receive investment
origination_types.DEVELOP: identify a productive activity that could become a new business or institution
origination_types.COORDINATE: identify an opportunity for existing organisations to jointly improve economic performance

no_candidate_id_required: origination creates a record with NO attaches_to. R3.15's rule that an intervention must attach to an existing candidate is kept for interventions and is not a restriction on originating opportunities.
names_no_company: an archetype is a SHAPE derived from an observed capability gap. It names no operator. An operator enters only through record_response(), so Dula originates by ASKING rather than by proposing.

archetypes.name: Regional food aggregation and distribution
archetypes.origination_means: identify a productive activity that could become a new business or institution
archetypes.what_it_does: consolidates product from many small northern producers into orders large enough for an institutional buyer to place and a vehicle to carry, and delivers them on a schedule a kitchen can plan around
archetypes.who_it_serves: school districts, hospitals, rural grocers, restaurants
archetypes.revenue_mechanism: a margin on product, or a fee per case or per stop
cost_drivers: working capital between paying a producer and being paid by an institution
must_be_true: enough buyers within reach of one route to share its cost
order values per stop that cover the contribution the route needs
producers able to meet buyer requirements for volume, pack and food-safety certification
a margin the buyers will bear
archetypes.operator_means: a business-model shape tied to an observed capability gap. No operator, no local validation. NOT an opportunity.
archetypes.scale_hint: the route arithmetic is in ec_interventions.route_economics; at 10 stops a $341-$676 loop needs $34-$68 of contribution per stop before anything else is paid for
archetypes.note: this is the archetype the ESO brief below is written for

archetypes.name: Shared cold storage and first-mile cooling
archetypes.origination_means: identify an opportunity for existing organisations to jointly improve economic performance
archetypes.what_it_does: provides cooling and short-term storage near production so product holds its quality long enough to reach an aggregation point
archetypes.revenue_mechanism: rental by pallet-position or by day; or a cooperative cost share
must_be_true: enough volume in one catchment to keep a facility utilised
producers willing to deliver to a shared point
an operator willing to carry the fixed cost between seasons
archetypes.operator_means: a business-model shape tied to an observed capability gap. No operator, no local validation. NOT an opportunity.
archetypes.note: COORDINATE rather than DEVELOP because the assets partly exist and the question is whether their owners would share them

archetypes.name: Inspected processing capacity for northern livestock
archetypes.origination_means: identify a productive activity that could become a new business or institution
archetypes.what_it_does: slaughters and processes northern livestock under inspection so the meat can be sold to retailers, restaurants and institutions
archetypes.revenue_mechanism: a fee per head, or a margin on processed product
must_be_true: enough head within a haul radius to keep a plant utilised
ranchers willing to commit animals on a schedule
a buyer base for the cuts a region actually produces
archetypes.operator_means: a business-model shape tied to an observed capability gap. No operator, no local validation. NOT an opportunity.
archetypes.note: held deliberately at SIGNAL. The repository's own Phase 2 finding argues AGAINST the obvious reading of C01, and an archetype must not quietly re-adopt a thesis the research already qualified.

archetypes.name: Regional production of an input currently sourced at distance
archetypes.origination_means: identify a productive activity that could become a new business or institution
archetypes.what_it_does: produces, fabricates or aggregates an input that local producers currently buy from a national or global supplier, close enough to cut freight and lead time out of every unit of local output
archetypes.who_it_serves: whoever performs the productive activity that consumes the input
archetypes.revenue_mechanism: a margin on the input, at a delivered price the buyer compares against their current supplier
must_be_true: enough regional volume to reach minimum efficient scale
a delivered cost below what the distant supplier charges
buyers willing to switch supplier
any certification the product requires
what_varies_by_place: whether a compatible manufacturer already exists
archetypes.operator_means: a business-model shape tied to an observed capability gap. No operator, no local validation. NOT an opportunity.
archetypes.note: THE COMPARATIVE-COST TRAP LIVES HERE. This archetype is only ever a hypothesis about whether local production would be CHEAPER DELIVERED than the supply it replaces. An import is not a loss, and distance is one cost among several. Any place hypothesis on this archetype that does not hold both delivered costs is holding neither.

archetypes.name: Succession acquisition of operating regional businesses
archetypes.origination_means: identify an existing business that could expand, be acquired, or receive investment
archetypes.what_it_does: acquires an existing profitable business from a retiring owner and keeps it operating, rather than letting it close
archetypes.who_it_serves: retiring owners, employees, the customers of a business that would otherwise close
must_be_true: owners actually intending to exit
businesses with earnings that service acquisition debt
a successor willing to operate, not only to own
archetypes.operator_means: a business-model shape tied to an observed capability gap. No operator, no local validation. NOT an opportunity.
archetypes.note: DISCOVER: the businesses exist and are observed as a population. What is not observed is any individual owner's intention, and R3.8 forbids inventing one.

archetypes.name: Coordinated institutional purchasing
archetypes.origination_means: identify an opportunity for existing organisations to jointly improve economic performance
archetypes.what_it_does: aligns several institutions' purchasing so that orders arrive in sizes a regional supplier can fill and a route can carry
archetypes.who_it_serves: school districts, hospitals, and the producers who would supply them
archetypes.revenue_mechanism: none directly: this is a cost borne by someone, usually a programme or a convening organisation
must_be_true: institutions near enough to share a delivery
procurement rules that permit a combined award
someone funded to do the coordinating
archetypes.operator_means: a business-model shape tied to an observed capability gap. No operator, no local validation. NOT an opportunity.
archetypes.note: the intervention IV_BUYER_AGGREGATION is the same idea evaluated against an existing candidate; this is the same idea asked as an origination question

briefs.subject: Regional food aggregation and distribution — Northern New Mexico
briefs.what_our_research_suggests: There may be an opportunity for regional food aggregation and distribution serving Northern New Mexico. Consolidates product from many small northern producers into orders large enough for an institutional buyer to place and a vehicle to carry, and delivers them on a schedule a kitchen can plan around.
why_we_think_so: 97 institutional buyers and 347 grocers in the entity population
a 262-mile loop costing $341-$676 on documented per-mile inputs
the condition recorded as exists_uneconomic north of Santa Fe
NM Grown programme funding with an OBSERVED committed capacity
what_we_have_not_established: whether buyers would pay a premium or require a discount
whether producers can meet institutional requirements at volume
briefs.the_honest_position: We have identified economic conditions consistent with this model. We have NOT established that it is viable, and we are not recommending it. No operator has been identified and we are not proposing one.
questions: Are you working with an entrepreneur or an existing business interested in this model?
Do you know operators who could help validate the economics?
Is there something in your experience that makes this model unworkable here?
Do you hold, or know who holds, any of: order value per stop; stops per loop; any distributor's margin?
what_a_response_would_change: an operator who exists and is interested moves this from a shape to a candidate
evidence that the model does not work RETIRES it, which is as useful and faster
a single operating figure may settle whether the economics close at all
we_are_not_asking_for: an introduction we have not earned

response_kinds.ALREADY_SUPPORTS_A_COMPANY: the respondent already works with a business doing this
response_kinds.KNOWS_AN_OPERATOR: the respondent can name a person or business that might
response_kinds.HAS_CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: the respondent has reason to think the model does not work here
response_kinds.DECLINED: no response, or declined to engage

promotion_attempts.why: AT_AGGREGATION: LOCALLY_VALIDATED requires the demand side AND the cost side observed here. demand_observed=False cost_observed=True. A route cost without an order value is half a business model.

the_position: Five archetypes, all at ARCHETYPE_HYPOTHESIZED, none validated, no operator identified and no response recorded. That is not a failure of the module -- it is the state of the question before anyone has been asked. The output of origination is a brief, and the next move is a human one.
